title: Engagement of Independent Engineer for the project - Development of tourism at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse on PPP basis.
summary: Technical corrigendum to a tender engaging an Independent Engineer for the DBFOT (PPP) tourism development project at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse, widening eligibility beyond TNIDB-empanelled consultants.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhawan, 5/20 Jaffar Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Mahabalipuram Lighthouse
sites.work: Independent Engineer for DBFOT (PPP) tourism development project

scope.item: Engagement of Independent Engineer for DBFOT (Design Build Finance Operate and Transfer) project - development of tourism at Mahabalipuram Lighthouse on PPP basis

eligibility: As amended: firms registered with any Central/State Government Departments/PSUs having experience and expertise in engineering consultancy services as Independent Engineer for PPP projects
Bidder shall have undertaken eligible assignments as Independent Engineer for PPP projects
Proof of certificate of incorporation/registration under Companies Act, Memorandum and Articles of Association, and registration with Central/State Govt./PSUs

corrigenda.change: NIT header, Section III, Section IV clause 4.1.1, NIT clause 12(1) and Section V clause 5.1.3: requirement of empanelment with Tamil Nadu Infrastructure Development Board (Panel nos. 10 and 23) replaced by registration with any Central/State Government department/PSU with Independent Engineer experience on PPP projects

notes: Only the technical corrigendum is attached; no NIT, cost, EMD or dates. Listing end 2024-07-23 and opening 2024-07-24 not in document. Related corrigendum for same work appears as nid 1599.
